# WenYuan Rounded SC font subsets

Source: https://github.com/takushun-wu/WenYuanFonts . Upstream family: WenYuan Rounded SC 1.100. License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; the complete copyright notices, Reserved Font Names and terms are retained in OFL.md.

The two local WOFF2 files are UI subsets for regular and bold, with the internal family renamed to JOJO WenYuan UI. Glyph outlines are unchanged. Characters outside the subset fall back to the system sans-serif font. The subsets do not claim to cover all Chinese characters and do not imply upstream endorsement.

The fonts are served locally. No remote font or tracking service is required. Their OFL terms remain separate from the project's noncommercial code and artwork licenses.
